data.one_liner: Lightweight and customizable logger for BLoC and Cubit built on Talker.
data.what_it_does: It logs BLoC and Cubit events, transitions, creations, and closings using the Talker logging base. You can attach it as a BlocObserver and filter logs or customize formatting options.
use_when: You want to log BLoC and Cubit events and state changes using Talker
You need customizable BLoC logging with filters for specific blocs
avoid_when: You are not using the BLoC state management library
You prefer built-in bloc logging without Talker
strengths: Integrates seamlessly with Talker for unified application logging
Supports event and transition filtering by bloc type
weaknesses: Tied specifically to the Talker logging ecosystem
data.setup_notes: Assign TalkerBlocObserver to Bloc.observer during application initialization.

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides the base BlocObserver functionality directly without needing Talker.
